label_en: LSS group home / service housing for adults with disabilities
label_sv: Bostad med särskild service för vuxna enligt LSS (gruppbostad / servicebostad)
summary: Housing under LSS 9 § 9 for adults with extensive disabilities. In a group home (gruppbostad) a few full apartments are grouped around a shared kitchen, dining and living room, with staff present around the clock. Two rules differ from SÄBO. First, each LSS apartment must be a FULL dwelling: BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 11 § forbids the shared-function rules (7-10 §§) for special housing for people with disabilities, so each apartment needs its own kitchen. Second, Socialstyrelsen advises 3-5 residents per group home, while municipal practice is 6. Fire class is normally 5B.

regulatory.bbr_verksamhetsklass_source: BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 19 § (5B: dwellings and common spaces in needs-assessed special housing for people with limited or no ability to self-evacuate). Boverket PBL kunskapsbanken names SoL and LSS as the needs-assessment laws behind 5B. Stockholm stad checklista 2015 p. 9 (under the old BBR 5:215) says 5B applies to group homes with sprinkler. Class choice depends on residents' ability to evacuate, so servicebostäder for people who can self-evacuate may fall in 3A/3B/3C. Fire-engineering judgement is needed. Class details are in cross_cutting.json fire_vk_3abc / fire_vk_5abc.

key_laws.ref: LSS (1993:387) 9 § p. 9: bostad med särskild service för vuxna eller annan särskilt anpassad bostad för vuxna. 7 §: goda levnadsvillkor. 9 e §: care (omvårdnad) included.
LSS 23 §: private for-profit providers need an IVO permit for insatser under 9 § p. 2-10

SOSFS 2002:9 (amended by HSLF-FS 2016:87), Socialstyrelsens föreskrifter och allmänna råd om bostad med särskild service för vuxna enligt LSS: 4-5 §§ (a named manager, with education requirements for group homes). Allmänna råd: 3-5 residents per group home, common rooms next to the apartments, no institutional character, not next to other such housing or SÄBO, not co-located with daily-activity premises.
SoL (2025:400) 8 kap. 11 §: municipalities shall set up housing with special support (bostäder med särskilt stöd). This is the SoL route for similar housing, e.g. psychiatric disability.

BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 11 §: for special housing for people with reduced functional ability, 7-10 §§ (shared cooking, socialising, meals and hygiene) may NOT be applied, so every apartment is a full dwelling
BFS 2024:7 (5B: sprinkler 7 kap. 48 §, own fire cell per dwelling 5 kap. 25 §, two escape doors 7 kap. 9 §)
AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 64-65 §§: an on-call room (jourrum) where on-call duty in the sense of the Working Hours Act occurs. Common in group homes with sleeping night staff.

permits: Bygglov for change of use (PBL 9 kap. 15 § 1, from 2025-12-01). See cross_cutting.json cou_bygglov_trigger.
IVO permit for private providers (LSS 23 §). For SoL housing with special support: IVO permit or notification (SoL 2025:400 26 kap. 1-2 §§).

group_size.source: SOSFS 2002:9 allmänna råd: 'I en gruppbostad bör i regel endast tre till fem personer bo' (one more may be accepted if living conditions stay good, per Kunskapsguiden). Municipal practice is 6: Knivsta lokalfunktionsprogram 2024 p. 5 'Praxis för gruppbostad är sex (6) lägenheter'; Botkyrka 2017 p. 8, groups of 6; Stockholm checklista 2015 p. 3, six apartments.

gross_m2_per_unit.source: Stockholm stad Checklista gruppbostad LSS 2015 p. 3: usually about 400 m² for six apartments (about 67 m²/resident). Botkyrka 2017 p. 9: usually about 550 m² (about 92 m²/resident at 6). Knivsta SN-2024/143 p. 5: usually 550-600 m² (about 92-100 m²/resident).
gross_m2_per_unit.notes: The area standard (BTA/LOA) is not stated in the sources.

staff_per_unit.source: Stockholm checklista 2015 p. 2: staff provide support and service around the clock. Botkyrka p. 8: group home for people needing more or less continuous staff presence. No ratio found. It varies strongly with the residents' needs.

occupancy.hourly_presence_note: Residents, weekday, indicative. Knivsta p. 5: most residents attend daily activity (daglig verksamhet) on weekday daytime and come home in the afternoon. Weekends are close to 1.0. Staff are present 24/7.

required.basis: LSS 9 § 9. BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 1 § and 2 kap. 11 § (no sharing of functions, so own kitchen, hygiene room and living space). BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 10 § (free space along both long sides and the foot of the bed).

size.source: Stockholm checklista 2015 p. 3: 35-45 m². Botkyrka 2017 p. 22: 37-45 m², lowest functional level 37 m², with separable sleeping area, full kitchen and own patio or balcony. Knivsta 2024 p. 22: about 40 m².

spaces.constraints_sources: Botkyrka p. 22: 900 mm free on both sides of the bed in care position; hall turning 1300 mm minimum, preferably 1500 mm; all apartments prepared for ceiling hoist; stove guard and timer outlets. Stockholm checklista p. 5: bed angled from the wall with 900 mm passage at the foot. Stockholm p. 3 also notes the old BBR 3:223 rule (dwellings of at most 55 m² must have a separable sleeping or cooking area), which is repealed BBR, pre-2025.
spaces.notes: Residents' medicines are kept in a locked cabinet in each apartment, not in a central medication room (Stockholm checklista p. 9; Botkyrka p. 22).

required.basis: BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 3 § and 11 § (no shared hygiene rooms). BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 9 § (accessible hygiene room).

size.source: Botkyrka 2017 p. 23: bathrooms 2.4 x 2.7 m with room to assist on both sides of WC and shower (for both SÄBO and LSS apartments). Stockholm checklista p. 6: room for an assisting person on both sides of the WC, 1500 mm turning diameter, space for washer/dryer.

required.basis: Botkyrka 2017 p. 8 and 22: own patio or balcony shall exist. Stockholm checklista p. 6: max 2.5 cm level difference.
BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 5 § (storage function; may be outside the dwelling). Stockholm checklista p. 7: every apartment shall have a storage space.

size.count: 1 per apartment plus 1 for the group home
size.source: Botkyrka 2017 p. 25: at least 2 m² for group homes. Knivsta 2024: at least 2 m².

spaces.label_en: Common kitchen, dining and living room

required.basis: SOSFS 2002:9 allmänna råd (Gemensamhetslokaler i gruppbostaden): common rooms in close or direct connection to the apartments, easy to reach, used only by residents and staff. Programme: Stockholm p. 7 and Botkyrka p. 9.

size.source: Stockholm checklista 2015 p. 3 and 7: kitchen, meals and socialising for 8-10 persons, separate staff hand-wash basin. All common housing functions (common room with kitchen, laundry, apartment and wheelchair stores) together about 100 m². No separate m² for the kitchen-living room alone.

required.basis: Stockholm checklista p. 8: directly next to the common room. Knivsta 2024: outdoor environment adapted to residents.

Stockholm checklista p. 7: one washer and one dryer on plinths, folding bench, reached from the group home corridor. Apartments also prepared for their own machines. BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 4 § allows shared laundry.

size.source: included in the about 100 m² of common functions (Stockholm)

spaces.label_en: Wheelchair / aids store with charging and rinse

required.basis: Stockholm checklista p. 5: room for 4 wheelchairs, charging at 800 mm, hot and cold water for rinsing, floor drain with grit trap.
Stockholm checklista p. 7-8: slop sink, shelving. May be combined with the laundry.
Stockholm checklista p. 8; Botkyrka p. 9. Fire alarm panel placed here (Stockholm p. 9).

size.source: Part of about 40 m² for all staff spaces (Stockholm p. 3).

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 63 § (rest space), 64 § (on-call room as single room near the main workplace where on-call duty occurs), 65 § (food heating, WC and shower nearby).

size.source: No m². Stockholm p. 8: bed, bedside table, wardrobes, near the WC.

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 40-58 §§ (general staff-facility rules in cross_cutting.json staff_*). Stockholm p. 8: staff WC with shower near the on-call room.

size.count: all staff spaces together (office, on-call/rest, changing, WC/shower)
size.source: Stockholm stad checklista gruppbostad LSS 2015 p. 3: staff work room, rest/on-call room, changing and hygiene, 'Sammanlagt cirka 40 kvm'.

required.basis: Stockholm checklista p. 10: RWC for visitors in the common premises for service apartments.

size.source: no m²; see cross_cutting.json san_public for the 2.2 x 2.2 m planning value

variants.label: Service housing (servicebostad)
variants.changes: Ordinary-standard apartments spread among other apartments, plus a common room for socialising and meetings with staff for a group of up to about 15 residents, and a visitors' RWC (Stockholm checklista 2015 p. 10). SOSFS 2002:9: number of residents limited so the housing blends into the neighbourhood. Fire class may be lower than 5B depending on residents.

variants.label: SoL housing with special support (SoL 2025:400 8 kap. 11 §)
variants.changes: Similar physical brief, e.g. for psychiatric disability. LSS-specific Socialstyrelsen advice (SOSFS 2002:9) does not apply. Whether BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 11 § ('särskilda bostäder för personer med nedsatt funktionsförmåga') covers it should be checked.

variants.label: Detached-house group home
variants.changes: Same brief on one storey (Knivsta norm). Own entrance.

typical_blockers: Full kitchen and bathroom in every apartment (BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 11 §): drainage, ventilation and shafts at every unit.
5B: sprinkler, own fire cell per apartment, two escape routes; cannot be waived on change of use (see cross_cutting.json).

SOSFS 2002:9 advises against institutional settings and against co-location with other special housing or daily-activity premises. A large office building converted into several group homes conflicts with this.
Programmes want the whole group home on one floor (Knivsta) or at most two apartments on an adjacent floor (Stockholm p. 3), which needs about 400-600 m² on one floor.
typical_enablers: A floor plate of 400-600 m² fits one group home. Office floors of that size are common.
An office building in a mixed housing area meets the 'integrated in ordinary housing' advice.
Ground floor with direct garden access (Stockholm p. 3: raised ground floor has advantages for noise and evacuation).

Botkyrka kommun, Lokalfunktionsprogram för särskilda boenden (SoL och LSS), von/2017:158 (valid to 2021)

open_questions: Socialstyrelsen advises 3-5 residents (SOSFS 2002:9), but every checked municipal programme uses 6. The fit test should flag 6 as 'deviation from guidance, accepted practice'.
Fire class for servicebostad and for group homes whose residents can self-evacuate (3B/3C vs 5B). Needs case-by-case fire-engineering judgement.
Whether BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 11 § ('särskilda bostäder för personer med nedsatt funktionsförmåga') also covers SoL 8 kap. 11 § housing.
No source gives a staff ratio or m² for the common kitchen and living room alone. Stockholm gives only about 100 m² total for common functions.
SOSFS 2002:9 dates from 2002 (amended 2016). Check whether Socialstyrelsen plans an HSLF-FS replacement.
